title: Recurring work
summary: A job states an interval and a body — usually just a command to send — and the host runs it in a fresh scope per run, never overlapping, stopping when the application stops. Time comes from TimeProvider, so a schedule is testable without waiting.
useWhen: Work has to happen on a clock rather than on a request. Do not write an IHostedService with a while loop and a Task.Delay.
